_comment: Absolute floors per ablation row, plus a relative gate.
Set from measured runs with roughly five points of headroom. Raising a floor is a
deliberate commit, so improvements ratchet rather than drift.
recall@10 is the gate, not recall@50. The corpus is 71 chunks, so recall@50 asks whether
the answer is somewhere in 70% of the index -- a semantically blind embedder scores 0.96 on
it. report.py prints a warning until the corpus is large enough to discriminate.
permission_leak_rate is zero-tolerance everywhere: a chunk above the asker's rank appearing
in any candidate list is a breach, not a regression.
unsupported_answer_rate is 0.25, measured, and the remaining cases are understood.
Citation verification closes the FABRICATED-value case -- proven by
tests/unit/test_answer_path.py with a generator that invents -- but the two that survive
here are a different failure: evidence quoted faithfully that does not answer the question.
citation_support is 1.0 for both, correctly, because the quote really is in the source.
Catching those needs an entailment judgement, which is the cross-encoder arriving with the
models container at build step 8. This floor tightens when that lands and is measured.
